Question: Assalamualaikum, My brother name is masoom, meaning is (bey ghuna) so can we keep this name? Answer ID: 15644 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1350/1376=L=1430) Yes, you can keep the name. Khwaja Masoom, the son of Mujaddid Alf Sani, was a great buzurg, hundreds of thousands people took bia?ah with him and countless people have benefited from him. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
